design.authority: one word per sector in the host's roster (roster.rs), raised at the ARRIVAL = the first FIXED_STATE or CITY_STATE statement under a sector placement's key after its insertion; the host's own scene table gives the box top; the arithmetic is one C kernel (model_step.c, expression csrc/sector_height_raise.h) under the model kernels' environment guard
design.reads: the sector float getter (sc_float.c) asks the host by the sector's coordinates (scan phase 17): the one read for the scan FIRST (unchanged text), the original-solver body, the fixed-wing clearance (unchanged text) and the pack; the candidate question's fact 12 is the host's word passed on and the host compares its bits
design.restore: scan phase 18 states the unpacked raw word to the host, which stores exactly those bits; the campaign checks the acknowledgement before the load goes on
design.retired: the legacy field is never written or read in a hosted build (census-guarded); no mirror, no fallback; the original body is compiled only where the original entity solver is kept (collision-fixture, model-fixture)
design.city: CITY_STATE gains the shape word (fact 9): a city raises only with a valid shape; the accepted baseline's 14395 cities were all invalid
design.classifiers: fact 12 is exempt from the finite classifiers (integer and floating mirror): any raw word is valid history
